name: light-beams
title: LightBeams
description: Stage lights shining down from the top edge, gently swaying.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) parks each beam at its resting angle.
